title: Fart with Reverb
blurb: Take the humble fart, put it in a cathedral, and something remarkable happens. Reverb is the cheapest upgrade in audio production and easily the funniest: the tail lingers, bounces off imagined stonework, and invites a moment of reflection nobody asked for. What was a two-star joke becomes a cinematic event with a sense of architecture. This is the version for slow-motion edits, dramatic reveals and any scene that would benefit from vaulted ceilings. Editors love it because the decay gives you something to cut on — the punchline keeps ringing long after the picture has moved along.
origin: The classic fart, elevated by professional-grade reverb.
